final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT r.ordervault, o.timespan, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault COLLATE BINARY = o.recordvault COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY r.ordervault, o.timespan), step2 AS (SELECT timespan, SUM(record_count) AS total FROM step1 GROUP BY timespan), step3 AS (SELECT SUM(total) AS grand_total FROM step2), step4 AS (SELECT step2.timespan, step2.total, step2.total * 1.0 / step3.grand_total AS ratio FROM step2 JOIN step3 ON step3.grand_total IS NOT NULL), step5 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS average_ratio FROM step4) SELECT step4.timespan, step4.total, step4.ratio, step4.ratio - step5.average_ratio FROM step4 JOIN step5 ON step5.average_ratio IS NOT NULL
